TOKEN_MALFORMED.message: This doesn't look like a Discord bot token.
TOKEN_MALFORMED.hint: The token has three parts separated by dots. Copy it from Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token.

TOKEN_INVALID.hint: It may have been regenerated or revoked. Generate a new one in Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token and paste it here.

TOKEN_NOT_BOT.message: This token isn't a bot token.
TOKEN_NOT_BOT.hint: A user account token won't work — and using one breaks Discord's terms. Create an application and use the token from the Bot tab.

APP_NOT_DEDICATED.message: This application already receives interactions at another address.
APP_NOT_DEDICATED.hint: The bot must be dedicated to this dashboard. Use a new application, or clear the "Interactions Endpoint URL" field in the Developer Portal before continuing.

APP_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE.message: This bot is already in many servers.
APP_IN_USE_ELSEWHERE.hint: Setting the token here changes how the application receives interactions, and that affects every server it's in. Use a dedicated bot.

BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD.message: Your bot isn't in this server yet.
BOT_NOT_IN_GUILD.hint: Without it in the server, no direct message can go out. Use the invite button to add it.

DISCORD_UNREACHABLE.message: I couldn't reach Discord right now.
DISCORD_UNREACHABLE.hint: This is usually temporary. Try again in a moment — nothing was saved.

ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE.message: The server isn't set up to store secrets safely.
ENCRYPTION_UNAVAILABLE.hint: This is our problem, not yours. The token wasn't saved. Let support know.
